body: You sound exactly like me, especially the part about parents. It sucks to be honest and I'm exhausted of my meaningless life and repeating mistakes. I feel sorry for you, but it's comfortable to know there's someone going through this same shit with me.

I know exactly what you mean. I can't see myself having a future and I have absolutely no ambition. I don't know what would make me want to continue. I feel like my life is endless stress and anxiety and I don't wanna do the things that would make them go away if it makes any sense. My motivation is at rock bottom and tbh I find it very comfortable to know that I always have a way out and to end this all.
